newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar to shut units at Calif. refinery.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar to shut units at Calif. refinery.

text.p: Ultramar Corp said Tuesday it will shut several hydroprocessing units later this week at its 100,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Wilmington, Calif.
A company spokeswoman said workers will clean units fouled up during two outages that struck the West this summer.
"When you've got power outages, everything gums up the lines," a refinery spokeswoman said.
She said weak refinery margins also prompted the shutdowns.

A refinery in the Pacific Northwest confirmed Tuesday it began cutting crude runs. With regional margins falling 21 percent from last quarter, refiners -- including Tosco and Unocal -- are considering slowdowns in product output.
Ultramar's repairs will lower its gasoline production, but the spokeswoman could not say how much output would be lost or how long maintenance would last at the Wilmington facility.
"It's gonna mean we have less reformer flexibility and will reduce some of our gasoline output," she said.
